rules: One backlog; keep all 85 TK IDs.
Select earliest release with runnable work: R1, R2, R3, R4. Shared SCOPED_R1_R4 tasks run for relevant implemented features only.
contract means concrete interface/schema; build means code plus local tests; verified means relevant observed environment evidence.
A verified dependency gates the dependent verification/release, not coding its interface or tests.
No external inventory, hardware model or professional approval is fabricated. Missing remote access blocks dependent verification only.
For runtime acceptance use ACCEPTANCE.md and the domain docs; a short task done_when is not the complete requirement.
Network/finance invariants and current permissions apply to every task.
